title: PDUNASS Inaugurates Joint EPFO–ITC-ILO Training Programme on “Actuarial Practices in Social Security: Strengthening Actuarial Governance at EPFO India”
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Labour & Employment

PDUNASS Inaugurates Joint EPFO–ITC-ILO Training Programme on “Actuarial Practices in Social Security: Strengthening Actuarial Governance at EPFO India”

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
11 AUG 2026 4:17PM by PIB Delhi

The Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya National Academy of Social Security (PDUNASS) inaugurated the residential phase of a specialized training programme titled “Actuarial Practices in Social Security: Strengthening Actuarial Governance at EPFO India”
on 10th August
 in New Delhi
.

Organized jointly by the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) and the International Training Centre of the International Labour Organization (ITC-ILO), the three-day residential phase (10–12 August 2026) follows a comprehensive online module conducted via the ITC-ILO e-Campus from 25 May to 9 August 2026.



Welcoming the Chief Guest and the ILO/ITC-ILO delegation, Shri Kumar Rohit, Director, PDUNASS, noted that the initiative aligns with PDUNASS’s mandate as EPFO’s apex training institute to bring internationally benchmarked learning to its officers. Expressing gratitude for the strategic partnership, he remarked:"With the EPF, EPS, and EDLI schemes aligning with the Code on Social Security, 2020, strengthening in-house actuarial capacity is both timely and essential."



Mr. Oktavianto Pasaribu, Deputy Director and Senior Advisor for Regional Partnership and Resource Mobilization, ILO, highlighted that the collaboration reflects the ILO’s commitment to strengthening social protection systems across South Asia. He emphasized that sound actuarial governance is central to the financial sustainability of social security institutions and commended EPFO’s proactive approach to building in-house capacity.



Presenting an overview of the curriculum, Mr. Charles Crevier, ITC-ILO Faculty, outlined the blended structure of the programme and the key residential themes, which include:

Actuarial valuation methods

Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Global best governance practices in social security institutions

Delivering the keynote address and formally declaring the programme inaugurated, Shri Ramesh Krishnamurthi, Central Provident
Fund Commissioner (
CPFC), observed that as custodian of retirement savings, pensions, and insurance for crores of workers, every actuarial decision at EPFO impacts the financial security of millions. He urged officers to elevate actuarial work into a strategic governance function and foster an evidence-based culture across EPFO."As EPFO continues to grow in size and responsibility, strengthening our actuarial capacity becomes increasingly important to strengthen governance and prepare better for future challenges."
 Said
Shri Ramesh Krishnamurthi, CPFC
.

The inaugural session and residential phase
were
attended by senior leadership and operational officers, including:

Financial Adviser & Chief Accounts Officer (FA & CAO), ACCs, RPFC-Is, RPFC-IIs, SOs, and ASOs from EPFO

Representatives and officials from ESIC

Other prominent experts present included Mr. Amjad Rabi (ITC-ILO Faculty), Ms. Divya Verma (Senior Programme Officer, ILO), and Mr. Karun Gopinath (National Project Coordinator, ILO).





About PDUNASS

The Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya National Academy of Social Security (PDUNASS) is the apex training and research institute of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), functioning under the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. Established in 1990, PDUNASS is dedicated to training, research, and consultancy in social security administration.

About ITC-ILO

The International Training Centre of the International Labour Organization (ITC-ILO), based in Turin, Italy, is the training arm of the ILO. It designs and delivers capacity-building programmes for ILO constituents worldwide—including governments, employers’ and workers’ organisations—in areas central to promoting decent work, social protection, and social security governance.
